title: Patient 6 - pre treatment
extract_protocol_ch1: Cryopreserved peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) from trial participants were stored long-term in liquid phase LN2. For sample preparation, cryotubes were partially submerged in a 37°C water bath until mostly thawed, then transferred to 15mL conical tubes with 9mL of pre-warmed, filter-sterilized RPMI Media (Gibco Cat# 11875093) and 10% by-volume fetal bovine serum (FBS; Hyclone Cat# SH30071.01HI). Cells were centrifuged for 5 minutes at 400g at room temperature, decanted, then resuspended in 1mL chilled (4°C) phosphate-buffered saline (PBS; Gibco Cat# 14190144) + 0.04% bovine serum albumin (BSA; Gibco Cat# 15260037) with 0.2U/µl of RNAse inhibitor (Sigma Cat# 3335399001). Initial cell counting and viability were performed using a Countess II automated cell counter (Invitrogen Cat# AMQAX1000) with a 1:1 dilution of trypan blue (0.4% solution, Gibco Cat# 15250061) to confirm sufficient cell yields and greater than 80% viability. Samples were then processed using the following 10X Genomics protocols.

Single cells were captured and barcoded using the 10X Chromium controller using its 3’ or 10x Flex (probe-based) whole transcriptome kits. Gel Bead-In EMulsions (GEMs) were prepared, followed by cDNA amplification and size-based cleanup. Final libraries were sent for sequencing using NovaSeq and NovaSeqX platforms to target at least 20k reads per cell.
data_processing: Raw FASTQs were run through Cellranger v7.1.0, using the GRCh38 human genome for alignment and otherwise default parameters.
10x genomics flex (probe-based) samples were aligned using the Cellranger “multi” function with human probe set v1 and using the patient-specific barcodes to deconvolute multiplexed samples.
Assembly: GRCh38 human genome & human probe set v1
Supplementary files format and content: Cell Ranger Feature Barcode Matrices (HDF5 Format)

original_count_review.target_set_name: Chromium Human Transcriptome Probe Set v1.0.1

source_metadata.cleanup_policy: Keep originals and stage until independent source/QC/identity/all-statistic validation passes; exact checksummed cleanup only.

constants.source_target_set: Chromium Human Transcriptome Probe Set v1.0.1
constants.source_normalization_policy: Raw per-type mean; per-cell TP10K then mean; per-cell log1p(TP10K) then mean. Each cell denominator is its retained RNA gene universe, also used for project RNA QC. This is an assay-defined fixed filter, not phenotype-driven or learned feature selection.
constants.source_mitochondrial_QC_policy: Mito fraction uses retained RNA counts and retained MT genes:11inFlex,13in3prime. These are observed-gene fractions, not assumed identical whole-transcriptome mitochondrial measurements. Record assay and coverage for downstream audit.
constants.source_barcode_policy: Original raw sample barcode matrices with provisional project500RNAcounts/200genes/20percentMT gates. No claim of reproducing author CellRanger calls, multiplet exclusion or original analysis QC.
constants.source_gene_availability_policy: All original feature metadata and excluded-count ledgers retained. Omitted geometry genes remain unavailable outside saved axis; no zero filling, deprecated-prefix stripping or merging with canonical genes.
constants.source_clinical_policy: Individual age, sex, subtype, dose, exact draw dates/intervals, pathology group, response, recurrence and survival not joined without exact original clinical crosswalk. R/NR prefixes remain opaque source labels; no outcome inferred.
constants.source_time_policy: Literal pre/post treatment phase; no temporal interval inferred from source code or file ordering.
constants.split_assignment: unassigned; all visits of each original Patient code stay together

physical_sample_mapping_evidence: Original source Patient code plus pre/post phase identifies one deposited draw. Eleven paired participants and two post-only participants; missing draws and unavailable trial participants not invented.
